extracted.name: Brown Butter Mini Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: Classic soft and chewy cookies filled with melty chocolate chips. Golden on the edges and soft in the center, they’re the perfect simple homemade cookie—warm, sweet, and comforting in every bite
instruction_lines: Line a baking tray with parchment paper.
Add the butter to a saucepan
Stir while the butter melts and foams.
Continue cooking until golden brown specks appear and the butter smells nutty.
Let the browned butter cool slightly.
In a large bowl, add the brown sugar
Pour in the cooled browned butter.
Fold in the mini chocolate chips.
Place the dough in the freezer for 10 minutes.
Scoop small dough balls using 1 teaspoon of dough each.
Place cookies on the baking tray with space between them
The edges should look lightly golden while the centers stay soft.
Let the cookies cool on the tray before moving them.
